answer: Require each agent to stake tokens and prove useful work before earning. It locks 30 tokens, receives a random task, signs its result, and gets three checks from established peers; an auditor replays samples. Honest work returns the bond and builds trust, while duplicate proofs forfeit it and suspend keys for 12 rounds. A farm of 500 accounts locks 15,000 tokens and pays for 1,500 reviews to earn. Public hashes expose reuse: one copied pulse echoes in the ledger, and fake names may cluster like a mirage around a lagoon, but each leaves a costly trail across the dune.
